newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market slow $110/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market slow $110/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Compared with Friday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand light to moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light.
